groups.activity: kill Symbilysts on Defense and Interception stages
conditions: Symbilysts spawn in higher numbers on Archon Hunt Defense and Interception stages; full squads spawn more of them.
All four parts roll independently off the same 1% table, so duplicates happen.
bonuses: Just run your weekly Archon Hunt and let the parts pile up; several players finish a full set without trying.
Loot frames work on Symbilysts: Nekros Desecrate, a Chesa Kubrow, and Ivara's Prowl if it can steal a part before the kill (needs 100% power strength).
Parts are cheap to buy or trade since Archon Hunts flooded the market; trade for whatever hasn't dropped.

disclosures.title: the old Murex farm still works
disclosures.body: Before Archon Hunts, Symbilysts only spawned on a Murex in Veil Proxima Railjack missions: a 30-minute window on one Grineer Veil node, kill 20 Sentients to finish the objective. It also drops an Anomaly Shard. It's rougher and time-gated, so treat it as a backup, not the main route. Re-queue the node from the nav console after finishing; aborting has cost players their drops.
